days.notes: After farm visit, begin the drive back to Kochi. Confirm taxi fare (₹3,200–3,500 fixed) before boarding. Carry a light raincoat as December showers are possible.

warnings: Auto‑rickshaw minimum fare often starts at ₹100 for short hops – always confirm distance first.
Unlicensed boat operators at Mattupetty Dam may overcharge; use the official ticket counter.
Shikara rides at Kundala Lake advertised at ₹250 are overpriced; official rate is ₹120.
Combined tour tickets for Chinnakanal attractions can be inflated – purchase separate tickets at each gate.
Heavy fog in December can restrict visibility at Top Station and cause road delays on NH 85.
Kochi airport transfer to Munnar is a fixed‑rate taxi (₹3,200–3,500); negotiate before boarding as meters are not used.

Cab/Auto Pricing Inflation: Local auto-rickshaws may quote a 'minimum fare' of ₹100 for short hops; confirm distance first. Local taxis typically cost ₹12–₹15 per km. Mitigation: Agree on a total fare (e.g., ₹500–₹800 for a 30 km round trip) or ask for a meter.

Boat Operator Scams: Unlicensed boat operators at Mattupetty Dam may charge ₹300–₹400 per ride, claiming 'premium' service. Mitigation: Use the official dam office ticket counter and verify the boat's registration number.

Shikara Ride Pricing: 'Premium' rides at Kundala Lake are advertised at ₹250, but the official rate is ₹120. Mitigation: Insist on the standard ticket at the lake office and negotiate any extra guide fees beforehand.

Tour Pricing Traps: Some 'guided' tours in Chinnakanal claim a combined entry fee of ₹500 for the waterfall and farm, but the official combined ticket is only ₹70. Mitigation: Purchase separate tickets at each entry gate and ask for a printed receipt.
Transport Logistics: Uber and Ola only operate to Munnar's outskirts. Beyond that, use local 'Munnar Taxi' apps (e.g., 'Munnar Cabs') which charge ₹12 per km and accept cash only.

Weather Visibility: During December–January, heavy fog may limit visibility at Top Station and can clog NH 85. An alternative route via Coimbatore (NH 181) can avoid morning fog but adds 30 minutes of distance on winding roads.
Dietary Caution: Non-vegetarian dishes frequently include beef or fish; specifically ask for 'vegetarian only' to avoid hidden meat stocks.
Airport Transfer: Taxis from Kochi Airport to Munnar have a fixed rate of ₹3,200–₹3,500 for the 130 km journey; negotiate this before boarding as meters are not used.
